implemented: Freezes a bounded stop/target grid and restricts trade and OHLC dates to the development window.
Uses the shared stop-first adverse resolver for same-bar stop/target collisions and exposes collision counts.
Includes declared round-trip cost in every per-trade net outcome and retains all grid/trade rows, including losses.
Rejects invalid bars, final-window access, non-development inputs, and over-budget plans.
blockers: No verified development dataset run or authoritative input-data registry binding is included.
Round-trip costs are supplied by the caller and are not independently calibrated here.
Daily bars cannot identify intrabar order; collision outcomes are conservatively penalized rather than observed.
